title: The Archive of Halcyon Drift Again
author: Noor Delacroix
blurb: Quentin Almeida, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
